Definition: trebly, i.e. (in time) day before yesterday
BiblicalUsage: Jacob sees that Laban's face is not toward him as before, and Moses tells the LORD he is not eloquent, neither heretofore nor since He spoke to him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the day before yesterday is the Bible's way of saying things were different then, and God works with the man I am now.
